svg.title: Скручивания с гантелью на груди — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Weighted floor abdominal crunch with one clearly visible small dumbbell held securely against sternum in both phases. Side-three-quarter camera. Athlete supine with bent knees and both feet planted. Left head, shoulders, and upper back on floor. Right curls shoulder blades and head only a little off floor toward pelvis, lower back and pelvis stay on floor, knees and feet unchanged. Same single dumbbell with cylindrical end weights and short handle held across chest. No disk, sit-up, bench or reaching forward. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
